study.question: Does either raw or scaled/gated target-match action summary recover most of their joint click-AUC utility when both observed and item-replacement local input derivatives are stopped, and does that recovery depend on task-specific residual routing?
study.hypothesis: The raw and scaled/gated match-action summaries carry partly substitutable predictive content. Either aligned action channel may recover most of the joint advantage over matched-width item-only replacements even with local match-summary input derivatives stopped. Task routing may alter this recovery. The fifth direction is a transformed/gated copy, not an independent source of historical observations; any benefit is conditional on inherited scale, support and nonlinear training.

study.proposed_difference: Observed limitation and trajectory review: baseline-din click AUC=0.6555440824; unchanged entry g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached=0.6667535475 remains the strongest supported single-seed utility reference. Earlier zero/context replacement and scorer-only branches (g1-r0024 and g1-r0025) were much weaker; split pool/summary branches g1-r0026 also underperformed the combined action-value path. Those negative trajectories are retained, not relabeled implementation failures. In attached mixed-content g1-r0035, raw-only/scaled-only click AUCs were 0.6658683269/0.6658657279 (task) and 0.6636240165/0.6642230836 (shared). They were near g1-r0034 both-observed endpoints 0.6662444305/0.6647487996, but derivative policies were not controlled. With both selected local input derivatives stopped, g1-r0037 observed minus item-duplicate AUC gaps are 0.0025457826 (task:0.6661693800-0.6636235974) and 0.0028710547 (shared:0.6646058218-0.6617347671). Both-match-action rotation under the same stops in g1-r0038 loses 0.0024257689/0.0026287073. These are conditional observations at one fixed seed, not proven causality, repeated support, action necessity for the whole model or original architecture contributions. The next missing cells retain only raw row0 or scaled/support-gated row4 actions, crossed with task/shared routing. The other row uses the stopped inherited item duplicate. Implement only an added branch in _match_action_content: in mixed content and match_observed_gradient=blocked, detach the retained observed match row before final replacement selection. Earlier helper code applied this flag only to the all-observed endpoint; no earlier executed mixed blocked case is claimed. Pool/ordinal actions and all ordinary item/context paths remain unchanged. Full observed and item_duplicate endpoint branches stay textually unchanged. No modules, buffers, RNG, input fields, feature statistics, loss or training settings are added. Eight content/routing cells result from four new standalone modules plus four existing g1-r0037 endpoints. Parameter/shape matching is planned, not measured locally; indirect optimization and feature-scale explanations remain. Auxiliary quality is a material tradeoff: g1-r0037 both-observed task cart/fav/buy AUCs=0.753517/0.784390/0.738912 versus DIN=0.849070/0.864897/0.870182. Report all tasks and original costs rather than present a click-only conclusion as a universal improvement. The available interface is proposal/source preparation only, with no torch or jsonschema installed and no host tensor/diagnostic execution endpoint. No dataset downloads, training, scoring, installation, held-out request or seed change are performed. Prospective host checks are in every variant note; past diagnostic receipts are not_requested. This proposal holds evidence-linked observations/revisions without modifying read-only evidence.jsonl or inventing a personal/memory writer. Preparation limitations: rg is unavailable, so bounded Python/sed reads were used; all preparation and failed tool costs remain in the wall budget. Completed local checks: exact supplied runtime study-schema validation using a dependency-free checker; allowed evidence/parent/protocol IDs; four distinct standalone module names/files and valid roles; in-memory syntax compilation; CONFIG/constructor-default agreement; 20 inherited methods unchanged; constructor body identical modulo selector defaults; inherited helper statements and both endpoints unchanged after removing only the added mixed-content stop branch; four variant class ASTs identical modulo defaults; allowed imports/direct-call I/O audit; AST-derived replacement/retained selector disjointness and stop coverage; and SHA256 matches in all variant notes. These passed. They do not certify tensor execution or whole-framework behavior. The task mentions validate_task.py, but no registered/executable official validator is exposed by the current interface; it was not run.
predictions: Within each routing cell, each retained channel recovers >50% of G=A11-A00, and I=A11-A10-A01+A00 is negative: substitutability on the AUC scale. These are prospective descriptive criteria; they do not establish significance or independent information.

If the source forward-content explanation survives derivative control, mixed-cell recovery remains qualitatively similar to attached g1-r0035 despite different optimization paths. The two derivative changes are bundled, so no single-gradient attribution follows.

Compute conditional action gains and content x routing interactions explicitly; an absolute interaction above0.0005 is a practical follow-up flag. Do not assume a routing interaction from a general task-routing advantage.
No learned parameter count increases; inference arithmetic of the new detach selector is unchanged in shape. Actual training/inference cost, peak memory and latency must be measured, not inferred.
All four task probabilities remain valid; auxiliary task deterioration and null/negative click results remain reportable. Primary selection stays full-population validation click AUC.
falsifiers: Either single retained channel failing to recover half of the matched stopped endpoint gap weakens symmetric substitutability; both failures favor joint encoding or optimization explanations.
Forward/mask/source/ownership/gradient/optimizer bridge failure invalidates matched attribution regardless of AUC.
Recovery present only with attached input derivatives, or inconsistent direction across later authorized paired seeds/user-cluster intervals, weakens a robust forward-content explanation.
Content effects explained by replacement variance/support or downstream capacity do not establish unique action information; r0038 rotation loss alone does not remove these alternatives.
No stable difference of conditional gains between task/shared routing weakens task-conditioning dependence. No improvement over the incumbent is a valid utility null, not experiment failure.
alternative_explanations: Single fixed seed and adaptive validation history; effects are conditional benchmark observations until independent authorized repetitions and paired uncertainty.
Replacement matches parameter count and coordinate width, not feature variance, information rank or gradient geometry. Nonlinear optimization and scale/support gates remain possible explanations.
A local derivative stop leaves downstream dense learning and indirect action-embedding learning through pool/ordinal paths active; it is not a freeze of whole-model optimization.
Shared routing averages four adapters while task routing selects one: parameter counts match but effective task capacity/gradient distribution differ.
Existing endpoints require source/optimizer parity bridging; same-seed reruns are checks rather than independent evidence.
Action information remains elsewhere in observed pool, ordinal summaries and frozen task masks; this experiment estimates marginal summary-channel utility, not total action removal.

The frozen official_offline history can contain delayed feedback not mature at prediction time. Auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within24h, not advertisement-specific conversion; production causal validity is not established.

Raw and scaled rows differ in gates and normalization; a partial-content difference can reflect conditional support or scale rather than distinct semantic content. Repeated adaptive validation comparisons can amplify chance patterns.
